snippet.title: She spent 20 years inside a DVD...
snippet.description:
Wishlist Buitopia DVD on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4665960/Buitopia_DVD/

Today is Jess’s Birthday! Can you find her a suitable gift?

Introducing Buitopia DVD, a short interactive DVD game. Make choices, solve puzzles and uncover secrets. A game about nostalgia, escapism and what lurks inside ‘dead’ physical media. Contains absurdist humour and occasional horror. 

Play it on PC or with a real DVD player
Coming October 2026

Please wishlist on Steam - it would really help me out :) 

Buitopia DVD website: 
https://www.nondoon.com

This project turned into a bit of an obsession over the past few years…  it basically took over my life… but I’m so excited to finally share it.  My sincere thanks to you for supporting this channel - I know it’s been a long time since I posted on YouTube. 

I've always found something strange about DVD menus, with their odd stutters and imperfections... I actually started making Buitopia over 20 years ago… then abandoned it once DVD became obsolete. Finishing it has been a way to say sorry to ‘Jess’ after all these years…

Voice acting: Harriet Titlow
A very special thanks to the talented Harriet Titlow for playing the role of Jess 

YouTubers/Press: If you’d like an early review copy, please fill in this form. I might even send you a copy of the Physical DVD! 
https://nondoon.com/buitopia-claim 

If you’d like to be notified when the physical edition drops, please join the newsletter
